info.title: Fairness Checker API
info.description: On-call fairness and burnout tracking for PagerDuty. Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login, then send the accessToken as a Bearer token (in Swagger UI: Authorize). Every error is an ApiError (RFC 9457 problem details, application/problem+json); branch on its code.

post.description: Signs out every other session and returns a fresh one.

Returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie. By default, 5 wrong passwords in a row lock the account for 15 minutes (423), and a client IP gets at most 10 attempts per minute (429). Both come with Retry-After.
Ends this session (every token from this sign-in) and clears the cookie.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Team access is changed separately (PUT /users/{id}/teams); leaving MANAGER clears it

UserAccountResponse.description: A login as admins see it. lockedUntil: set while locked after failed sign-ins

CreateUserRequest.description: ENGINEER needs engineerId (an engineer without a login); only MANAGER takes teamIds

TemporaryPasswordResponse.description: Shown once: give it to the user, who must change it at first sign-in

WebhookEventDetail.description: One received PagerDuty webhook with the body PagerDuty sent

TokenResponse.description: Send accessToken as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>' until expiresAt, then call /api/v1/auth/refresh (the refresh token travels in an httpOnly cookie)

UserResponse.description: The signed-in user. teams: the teams they can see (every team for an ADMIN, the managed ones for a MANAGER, their own for an ENGINEER)

WebhookEventResponse.description: One received PagerDuty webhook (without its body; see GET /webhook-events/{id})

running.description: Whether a sync of this kind is running now, on any instance

lastSuccess.description: Null before the first successful sync

SyncRunResponse.description: One PagerDuty sync. For ONCALLS, createdCount is the number of shifts stored (new or merged) and updatedCount is null. A SUCCEEDED run may still name an error: incidents that couldn't be stored.

triggeredBy.description: The admin who started a MANUAL run

SyncStatusResponse.description: The latest sync of each kind, for a "last synced 4 minutes ago" display

scheduled.description: Whether this instance runs the scheduled sync

intervalSeconds.description: Time between scheduled syncs; null when not scheduled

ScoresStatus.description: available: whether the scorer's figures are included. reason when not: SCORER_UNAVAILABLE, or SEVERAL_TEAMS (pick one team to get scores)

Kpi.description: A figure for the window and the same-length period before it. changePct is null when there's nothing to compare with

Summary.description: gini, fairnessLabel and highRiskEngineers come from the scorer and are null when scores aren't available (see scores); highRiskEngineers is also null for engineers

HeatmapCell.description: dayOfWeek: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; hour 0-23. Both in each team's own timezone

SeriesPoint.description: One day, ISO week (from Monday) or month, by its first day

Snapshot.description: Everything the analytics page and the reports show, computed once. loadShare and burnout are limited to your own row if you're an engineer

ApiError.description: Problem details (RFC 9457) returned for every error

type.description: Problem type; always about:blank, see code instead

detail.description: What went wrong, for people; may change, so don't parse it

instance.description: Path of the request that failed

code.description: Stable error category for programs to branch on

errors.description: Problems with individual fields or parameters; empty when none

requestId.description: Same value as the X-Request-ID response header; quote it when reporting a problem

bearerAuth.description: accessToken from /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/refresh; valid for 15 minutes

refreshCookie.description: httpOnly cookie set by login; the browser sends it by itself
refreshCookie.name: fairness_refresh
